summary: Daniel Bradly (Brad) Sethness, 32, of Crested Butte, killed in an avalanche near the eastern flank of the south bowl of Ruby Mountain at treeline near Kebler Pass; the slide broke loose while the group used a snowmobile to tow a snowboarder off a jump, and Sethness was carried to a tree well; Irwin Guides and party members dug him out and continued CPR during transport to Gunnison Valley Hospital, where he died at ~10 p.m.
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue (standby); Irwin Guides; Crested Butte EMTs
notes: Reported in avalanche-center 2015-16 season index Victim count corrected 2026-09-11: the CBN account ("Avalanche resulting in death of one") and KVNf both report a single victim; the avalanche-center index entry that read "two killed" was conflated. Slide ~2:00 p.m., avalanche danger Considerable (3). Run 61 CAIC merge: CAIC 2015-16 season table row — 2 caught, 1 partially buried uninjured, 1 fully buried and killed, Ruby Peak, Ruby Range west of Crested Butte.
